crisis.title: Science is stranded onboard
crisis.body: Recorder is 77% full (198 of 256 MB). The polar imager produces 1.20 Mb/s in sunlight. The compact x-band sends at 0.20 Mb/s, but only during a 25-minute ground contact once per 118-minute orbit, about 21% of the time. Averaged over an orbit it returns 0.04 Mb/s while the instrument generates 0.47 Mb/s on average, so data piles up between contacts.

actions.effect: Halve new data and science for the remaining campaign. Matches data volume to the recorder and saves power.
